What can I purchase with my Cinepolis Gift Cards?
You can use your Cinepolis Gift Card to book tickets for movies across various formats at  Cinepolis.
Can I send a Cinepolis Gift Card to someone else?
Yes, you can send Cinepolis Gift Cards using the “I am Gyfting” option on GyFTR.

Choose the desired denomination you want to send.

Where can I use the Cinepolis Gift Card?

To recover your Gift Card, visit https://www.gvhelpdesk.com/ & use the ‘I WANT TO RESEND MY VOUCHER’ section of this page.
